scientific_limitations: Exact optimization is over centered regular polygons, not all convex polygons.
Unrestricted conclusion is a sufficient sharp-weight range excluding both nested classes, not a global optimizer classification.
The strict-convexity result applies to the regular-family optimal sequence, not the full open unrestricted approximation sequence.
Earlier unindexed treatments of weighted perimeter deviation may exist.
title: A sharp weighted-perimeter transition and strict convexity for regular approximations of a disk
